ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) internal surface area (~75%) contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral boundaries and central notch region (~25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric fields on both lobes; irregular, thick black boundary mapping the entire trailing edge and extending deeply into the median notch; discrete dark circular pixel clusters located in the mid-white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern; continuous irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge from tip to notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve along the primary trailing edges, with sharp concavity at the approach to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of five distinct circular dark pixel clusters: one on the mid-left lobe and four on the mid-right lobe (three in a cluster, one isolated lower).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear disruption visible near the apical tip of the right lobe; minor vertical linear disruptions near the black-white transition zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, thickened dark tissue morphology on the extreme outer tips (apices) of both lobes; multiple circular pigment scars on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'bleeding' effect where black trailing edge pigment encroaches into the white field with stochastic, jagged boundaries.
